arxiv-1811-10151.title: Search for dark matter in events with a leptoquark and missing transverse momentum in proton-proton collisions at 13 \TeV
arxiv-1811-10151.description: Abstract A search is presented for dark matter in proton-proton collisions at a center-of-mass energy of s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV using events with at least one high transverse momentum ( \pt ) muon, at least one high- \pt jet, and large missing transverse momentum.

It is the free proalgebraic group on a set of cardinality | ℂ | |\mathbb{C}| . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 14L15, 34M50 1.

arxiv-2312-12981.title: Hardness of linearly ordered 4-colouring of 3-colourable 3-uniform hypergraphs
arxiv-2312-12981.creator: Marek Filakovský, Tamio-Vesa Nakajima, Jakub Opršal, Gianluca Tasinato, Uli Wagner
arxiv-2312-12981.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Marek Filakovský, Tamio-Vesa Nakajima, Jakub Opršal, Gianluca Tasinato, Uli Wagner. A linearly ordered (LO) k k -colouring of a hypergraph is a colouring of its vertices with colours 1 , … , k 1,\dots,k such that each edge contains a unique maximal colour. Deciding whether an input hypergraph admits LO k k -colouring with a fixed number of colours is NP-complete (and in the special case of graphs, LO colouring coincides with the usual graph colouring).

arxiv-2403-10937.title: Initial Decoding with Minimally Augmented Language Model for Improved Lattice Rescoring in Low Resource ASR
arxiv-2403-10937.creator: Savitha Murthy 1,*, Dinkar Sitaram 2
arxiv-2403-10937.description: Abstract Automatic speech recognition systems for low-resource languages typically have smaller corpora on which the language model is trained. Decoding with such a language model leads to a high word error rate due to the large number of out-of-vocabulary words in the test data. Larger language models can be used to rescore the lattices generated from initial decoding.

arxiv-2403-15206.title: Scattering matrix approach to dynamical Sauter-Schwinger process: Spin- and helicity-resolved momentum distributions
arxiv-2403-15206.creator: M. M. Majczak, K. Krajewska, J. Z. Kamiński, A. Bechler
arxiv-2403-15206.description: Abstract Dynamical Sauter-Schwinger mechanism of electron-positron pair creation by a time-dependent electric field pulses is considered using the S S -matrix approach and reduction formulas. They lead to the development of framework based on the solutions of the Dirac equation with the Feynman- or anti-Feynman boundary conditions. Their asymptotic properties are linked to the spin-resolved probability amplitudes of created pairs.

arxiv-2407-07335.title: Causal Leverage Density: A General Approach to Semantic Information
arxiv-2407-07335.creator: Stuart J Bartlett Division of Geological and Planetary Sciences California Institute of Technology Pasadena, CA 91125 United States
arxiv-2407-07335.description: Abstract . I introduce a new approach to semantic information based upon the influence of erasure operations (interventions) upon distributions of a system’s future trajectories through its phase space. Semantic (meaningful) information is distinguished from syntactic information by the property of having some intrinsic causal power on the future of a given system.

arxiv-2510-04201.title: World-To-Image: Grounding Text-to-Image Generation with Agent-Driven World Knowledge
arxiv-2510-04201.creator: Moo Hyun Son, Jintaek Oh, Sun Bin Mun, Jaechul Roh, Sehyun Choi
arxiv-2510-04201.description: Abstract While text-to-image (T2I) models can synthesize high-quality images, their performance degrades significantly when prompted with novel or out-of-distribution (OOD) entities due to inherent knowledge cutoffs. We introduce World-To-Image , a novel framework that bridges this gap by empowering T2I generation with agent-driven world knowledge.

pmc-11535151.creator: Erica K Sloan
pmc-11535151.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). pmc-12429103.title: Effect of Zr Additions on the Microstructure and Elevated-Temperature Mechanical Properties of Al–Cu–Mg–Ag–Zn–Mn–Zr Alloys
pmc-12429103.creator: Haoyang Fu, Hongda Yan, Bin Wei, Bin Sun, Zihang Liu, Weihong Gao, In-Chul Choi
pmc-12429103.description: This study systematically investigates the influence of Zr additions (0–0.24 wt.%) on the microstructure evolution and mechanical properties of Al–4.0Cu–0.5Mg–0.5Zn–0.5Mn–0.4Ag alloys under peak-aged conditions. Alloys were subjected to homogenization (420 °C/8 h + 510 °C/16 h), solution treatment (510 °C/1.5 h), and aging (190 °C/3 h).

pmc-12444483.title: Excision of urethral caruncle using a sealing device (LigaSure™): A case report
pmc-12444483.creator: Pin-Yu Chen, Hui-Kung Ting, En Meng
pmc-12444483.description: We report a case of a 74-year-old postmenopausal woman with stage III cystocele and a non-circumferential urethral caruncle presenting with bulge, voiding difficulty, occasional bleeding, and meatal discomfort. She underwent anterior colporrhaphy followed by excision of the urethral caruncle using the LigaSure™ device. The procedure was completed within 1 min, with minimal blood loss and no suturing.

pmc-13030597.title: Evaluation of the Ionospheric Corrections Generated by Smartphones with Different Real-Time Products
pmc-13030597.creator: Yan Zhang, Yang Jiang, Yang Gao
pmc-13030597.description: Ionospheric delay is a dominant error source in global navigation satellite systems (GNSSs). Conventional ionospheric estimation relies on dense networks of expensive geodetic receivers, limiting accessibility and coverage. With the widespread availability of multi-frequency, multi-constellation smartphones capable of carrier-phase tracking, this study investigates smartphone-based ionospheric estimation.

pmc-13242482.title: Effect of spinal fusion length on hip and knee osteoarthritis: a comparative cohort study of no fusion, short-segment fusion, and long-segment fusion
pmc-13242482.creator: Yusuf Sülek, İsmail Demirkale, Rodi Ertoğrul, Hacı Mustafa Özdemir
pmc-13242482.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeLumbar fusion alters spinal–pelvic biomechanics and may influence degenerative changes in the lower extremities. This study investigated whether fusion length is associated with radiographic progression of hip and knee osteoarthritis.MethodsIn this retrospective, single-center cohort study, patients aged 40–65 years who underwent lumbar surgery between 2010 and 2021 were grouped as no fusion (N), short fusion (S; ≤3 levels), or long fusion (L; ≥4 levels).

pmc-13537779.title: Exploring Medical Students’ Perceptions of Empathy Training in The Indian Attitude, Ethics, and Communication Curriculum: An Exploratory Qualitative Descriptive Survey
pmc-13537779.creator: Shruti Singh, S Kirubakaran, Prashant Kumar Singh, Riya Ranjith Vaidyar, Kye Mon Min Swe, Punit Patel, Dheerendra Kumar Mishra
pmc-13537779.description: Background:Empathy is widely recognized as a core component of patient-centered care and an important professional competency for medical graduates. In India, the attitude, ethics, and communication (AETCOM) module was introduced within the competency-based MBBS curriculum to foster empathy, communication skills, and professionalism. However, limited qualitative evidence exists regarding students’ experiences of empathy-focused teaching within this curriculum.

pmc-13563389.title: The European Multidisciplinary Evidence‐Based Guideline on Pancreatic Cancer: Methodological Protocol
pmc-13563389.creator: Laura C Leeuwenburgh, Magdalena Holze, Dena Akhoundzadeh, Adnan Alsourani, Ricardo Alvarez Jimenez, Paul C M Andel, Charlotte Baggerman van Houweninge, Alberto Balduzzi, Caro L Bruna, Fabio Casciani, Alice Cattelani, Aniek E van Diepen, Heleen Driessens, Daphne H M Droogh, Jeska A Fritzsche, Eline v
pmc-13563389.description: BackgroundPancreatic cancer remains one of the most lethal cancers despite extensive efforts and research conducted over the past decades. To effectuate groundbreaking improvements in pancreatic cancer treatment, interdisciplinary and international collaboration is essential. Evidence‐based guidelines, including state‐of‐the‐art evidence and expert opinion, are crucial to guide medical specialists, researchers, and patients, especially on issues where consensus is still lacking.

pmc-13660091.title: Prevalence and genotype distribution of high-risk HPV in Sarawak, East Malaysia
pmc-13660091.creator: Cassandra Sheau Mei Chee, Shirley Siang Ning Tan, Mohamad Adam Bujang, Izzati Binti Wan Maharuddin, Adam Malik Bin Ismail, Rehn Peterson Peter, Rahmah Binti Rashid, Nur Fatihah Oh Abdullah, Mohammad Nazarudin Bin Bahari, Veronica Lugah, Keh Li Yew, Pei Jye Voon, Melissa Siaw Han Lim
pmc-13660091.description: BackgroundCervical cancer remains a significant public health burden in Malaysia, with persistent infection by high-risk papillomavirus (hrHPV) as the primary cause. However, community-based data on HPV prevalence and genotype distribution, particularly in East Malaysia, remain limited. This study aimed to determine hrHPV prevalence, genotype distribution, and associated factors in a large community-based screening cohort in Sarawak.

pmc-13688707.title: Involving Independent Mental Capacity Advocates (IMCAs) in Dental Care Decision‐Making: A Qualitative Exploration of Dentists’ Experiences in England and Wales
pmc-13688707.creator: Naomi Murray, Jeena Patel, Lucy Taylor, Jordan A. Parsons, Andrew Geddis‐Regan
pmc-13688707.description: IntroductionDelivering dental care to individuals who lack decision‐making capacity involves complex ethical, legal, and clinical considerations. In England and Wales, Independent Mental Capacity Advocates (IMCAs) are required to support decisions about ‘serious medical treatment’, a concept given only broad definition in law.
